query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 FROM episode_references er
                        JOIN series s ON er.series_id = s.id AND s.library_id = $2
                        JOIN media_files mf ON er.file_id = mf.id
                            AND mf.is_available = TRUE
                            AND mf.tombstoned_at IS NULL
                        WHERE er.season_id = $1
                    ) AS "exists!"
